context_for_next_testing_agent: Auth system rewritten to pure client-side blockchain identity. No JWT tokens, no /api/auth/* endpoints. WIF private key is the identity - derived client-side via bitcoinjs-lib. Two auth modes: Import Key (paste WIF) and New Wallet (generate keypair). On-chain profile lookup via p2fk.io. Unlock wallet flow shows modal for returning users when sessionStorage is cleared but localStorage has wallet data.
